assets.limits: The saying concerns the limits of understanding another person’s experience; it does not specify pregnancy, a diagnosis or a gendered trait.
assets.required_action: Retain a respectful listening scene but use a neutral abdominal silhouette and a light hand-at-side or upper-abdomen gesture rather than cradling. An older adult would also diversify the age range. Do not imply medical diagnosis or pregnancy.
